final:
-- Factorial of n as an arbitrary-precision integer.
-- Phase 2: bodies filled in; signature and contracts unchanged.

fact(n: int) -> bigint =
  pre n >= 0
  ex fact(0) == 1
  ex fact(5) == 120
  -- Multiply in bigint so no step overflows the checked 64-bit int.
  -- Assumes bigint(i) converts an int to a bigint.
  var acc: bigint = 1
  for i in range(2, n + 1)
    acc *= bigint(i)
  acc

test_fact() =
  assert fact(0) == 1
  assert fact(5) == 120
  assert fact(25) == 15511210043330985984000000
